name: Red Turquoise Discus (Show Grade)
description: High-body Symphysodon aequifasciatus with vibrant electric blue striations over deep crimson base. Conditioned on beefheart & spirulina granules.

name: Halfmoon Plakat Betta (Avatar Copper)
description: Metallic turquoise-scale Plakat with crisp 180-degree caudal spread. Thrives in tannin-rich blackwater or heavily planted nano setups.

name: Platinum Dumbo Ear Mosaic Guppy (Trio)
description: Pure line-bred strain featuring oversized pastel pectoral fins and high-contrast mosaic tail patterning.

name: Bloody Mary Neocaridina Shrimp (Colony of 10)
description: Deep wine-red translucent tissue coloration bred in planted tanks. Superior algae and biofilm grazers for aquascapes.

name: Bucephalandra 'Kedagang' Clump on Lava Rock
description: Dark plum-green ruffled leaves sprinkled with metallic silver micro-dots (pearling pores). Ready to place directly into hardscape crevices.

name: Micranthemum 'Monte Carlo' (In-Vitro Cup)
description: Sterile laboratory-grown foreground carpeting flora. Forms lush, bright emerald cascading mats over aquasoil and driftwood.
